Published in *Ecological Informatics*, vol. 96, article 103839. [doi:10.1016/j.ecoinf.2026.103839](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecoinf.2026.103839) · [arXiv:2510.02830](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.02830)

Evaluates five large language models on 21,955 IUCN Red List species across four tasks. LLMs handle taxonomic classification well (94.9%) but systematically fail at conservation status assessment (27.2%) — documenting how closed-book LLMs fail is itself the contribution.
